fields.raw_value: Monarch Serenity is what you ever imagined your home to be - calm, comfortable, luxurious & and most of all affordable. Situated in a pollution and noise-free location at Thanisandra, it is in close proximity to the finest International Schools, Health Care Centres, Bangalore International Airport and Manyata Tech Park .This property is soon on its way to becoming a central landmark in North Bangalore. This project comprises of a commercial and a residential complex, the parking and entrances of which are entirely separate as we are truly concerned about conserving your privacy.
